visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-4%) fixed on entire body to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 on cards and sections. Use 1px inner glow on glass elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient glows from accent colors. No flat drop shadows. Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(226,255,74,0.15)] for key active elements.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimalist. rounded-none for sharp tech sections or max rounded-xl for product cards.

layouts.spacing: Generous. p-12, p-16, py-32 for sections. Breathing room is critical.
layouts.grid: Tetris Grid (asymmetric) for features. E.g. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12, item1 col-span-8, item2 col-span-4.
layouts.hero: Massive typography, 'Techin By Raj' filling 70% viewport width. Overlay product image bg-black/40.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered list layout with massive serif or mono numbers, left aligned.
layouts.marquee: Slow, editorial marquee with serif/mono typography outlining core features. bg-[#E2FF4A] text-black or reverse.

motion.reveals: Framer Motion line-by-line masked text reveals on load and scroll.
motion.interactions: Hover states on buttons and cards (-translate-y-1, border color shift to accent).
motion.parallax: Subtle framer-motion useScroll to slightly shift background or floating chart motifs.

components.buttons: Pill shaped (rounded-full) or completely sharp (rounded-none). bg-[#E2FF4A] text-black for primary CTA. Hover: scale 0.98.
components.cards: Crystal Glass or Technical Grid look. border-white/10, backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized: bg-transparent, border-b-2 border-white/20, text-white, rounded-none, focus:border-[#E2FF4A].
components.header: MUST NOT be pure transparent. Use Crystal Glass backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#050505]/60.

images.description: Candlestick stock chart on dark screen - use for indicator product card/showcase.
Luxury trading setup desk in dark room - use for Pro video course background or Hero subtle bg.
Another dark candlestick screen for the Beginner/Pro course imagery.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio. Grey text must not be darker than #71717A.
accessibility.testing: All interactive buttons and forms MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Only use Cabinet Grotesk.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on headers; always use backdrop-blur + rgba.
The hero must feature the text 'Techin By Raj' overlapping elements, revealed line-by-line via Framer Motion masking.
Use exact accent color #E2FF4A for CTAs.
Make product cards feel premium using 1px white/10 borders and very subtle noise textures.
Avoid the generic centered alignment disease. Make it heavily left-aligned and asymmetric.
Pricing section should highlight the Indicator at ₹5499 prominently.
Include data-testid on all buttons and form elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
NEVER apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
